items.text: Started game. Went on tutorial mission. Door access to my ship broke while out uninstalling salvage. Found out when trying to re-enter ship to get air. Died of asphyxiation while desperately trying to bash down door to get oxygen. 10/10 game.
items.text_zh: 开始游戏。去做教程任务。在外面拆卸回收物时，通往我飞船的门禁坏了。试图重新进入飞船获取空气时才发现。在拼命砸门想拿到氧气时窒息而死。10/10游戏。

observations.description: 离船时飞船门禁损坏，无法重新进入
observations.evidence: Door access to my ship broke while out uninstalling salvage.
observations.evidence_zh: 在外出拆卸回收物时，我飞船的门禁坏了。
